entry_item.definition: n. Board (in general); wooden printing blocks; the two wooden boards between which Mongolian and Tibetan books are preserved; binding or cover of a book, folder for letters, documents; volume; tortoise shell.
planche, des plancnes pour emballer entre elles des effets; les planches d'imprimerie; 2 attelles d'un collier de cheval; 3 l'écaille d'une tortue; 4 reliure, volume.

example.definition: graver (des lettres) sur des planches de bois

entry_item.definition: zwei Bretter um etwas dazwischen zu legen; die Schildkrötenschalen; die Buchdeckel
n. The covers of a book, two boards of wood used for keeping an unbound book together. Boards for supporting or pressing anything. Shells of the tortoise or turtle.

хавтас(н)-ы харьяал., переплётный; хавтасны тасаг переплётная.
